strengths.item: The paper has a conventional and generally logical organization: introduction/related work, methodology, experimental setup, results, ablations, conclusion, and appendix.
The high-level method structure is understandable, with the main components separated into stereo patch matching, sparse stereo refinement, fast feature fusion, and a training loss.
Core experimental comparisons are presented in standard forms, including rate-distortion plots, BD-rate tables, visual comparisons, complexity tables, and ablations.
Equations are mostly readable and numbered consistently, and the experimental section defines datasets, metrics, baselines, and implementation details.

weaknesses.item: Several visual elements are difficult to inspect at page scale: architecture diagrams, Figure 5 legends/tick labels, Figure 6 thumbnails and overlaid labels, and block labels in Figures 3–4 are small or cramped.
There are visible formatting and polish issues, including red revision-like text in the main body and captions, a fully red Figure 2 caption, and reliance on red/blue coloring in Table 1.
The writing contains multiple typos and spacing/capitalization issues, including “MULTI-SALE,” “LOSS FUCTION,” “simplicity,we,” and “best results inred.”

Notation in the method section is dense and sometimes ambiguous, with variables such as h_y, h_y*, h_y**, disparity maps, channel index g, and mapping/scaling conventions introduced quickly and not always explained clearly.
Some captions are informative but terse, especially for complex figures where the reader would benefit from clearer guidance on what visual evidence to inspect.

dimension_review.evidence_summary: The PDF inspection found that pages 1–2 are readable and clean, and the overall ICLR-style layout is mostly conventional. However, page 4 Figure 2 has many small labels and a red caption; page 5 Figures 3–4 are cramped with small labels; page 6 contains red revision-like text and the typo “Loss Fuction”; page 7 Figure 5 has small legends and tick labels; page 8 Table 1 is mostly legible but includes formatting/typo issues such as “inred”; and page 8 Figure 6 has useful visual comparisons but small thumbnails and PSNR/BPP labels. Text inspection also found unclear equation references such as “by 3,” dense notation around Equations 5, 7, and 8, and central method-section typos such as “MULTI-SALE FEATURE-DOMAIN.”
dimension_review.rationale: The paper is readable and reasonably organized, and reviewers can follow the broad technical and experimental story. However, the presentation is not polished enough for a good score: small and cramped figures, visible red markup, typos in headings and captions, and dense/inconsistent notation create notable friction when verifying the method and results. These issues go beyond minor formatting problems, so the presentation is best rated as fair rather than good.
